pr_title: Avoid wrapping rejection exception in exchange
pr_body:
We should avoid wrapping EsRejectedExecutionException in an ElasticsearchException as it would change the status code from 429 to 500. Ideally, we should avoid wrapping exceptions altogether, but that would require bigger changes.

Closes #112106

issue_context.title: ESQL: Full task queue leads to 500 errors instead of 429
issue_context.body:
Sometimes, the compute engine's tasks get rejected by the thread pool executor because its queue is full. These rejections get bubbled up as internal server errors (500), but they should be 429 as we receive more esql requests than can currently be handled.

The failures happens at `ExchangeSourceImpl.checkFailure(ExchangeSourceHandler.java:56)`
